Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: create-quasar tests

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  # the release-tests workflow reruns this suite at the released tag
  workflow_call:
  # direct pushes are the norm in this repo — they get the same
  # path-scoped coverage as PRs (rapid push trains collapse through the
  # per-ref concurrency group)
  push:
    branches:
      - 'dev'
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/create-quasar-tests.yml'
      - 'create-quasar/**'
      # root dependency changes affect every package
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches:
      - 'dev'
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/create-quasar-tests.yml'
      - 'create-quasar/**'
      # root dependency changes affect every package
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'

# literal prefix instead of github.workflow: when called from another
# workflow, github.workflow resolves to the CALLER's name, which would
# collide with the other suites called from the same run
concurrency:
  group: create-quasar-tests-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  unit-tests:
    permissions:
      contents: read # to fetch code (actions/checkout)
      pull-requests: read # to list the changed files

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: create-quasar

    # the expensive e2e matrix only runs when the scaffolding itself may
    # have changed; PRs merely touching the root dependency files stop
    # after the unit tests
    outputs:
      e2e: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.e2e }}

    name: Unit tests for create-quasar
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm i

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: pnpm test:unit

      # changed files come from the API per event kind; anything
      # uncertain (unknown event, API failure, a possibly-truncated
      # compare listing) falls back to running the matrix
      - name: Determine whether the e2e matrix should run
        id: scope
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ]; then
            FILES=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/files" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' || echo __ALL__)
          elif [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "push" ]; then
            FILES=$(gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/compare/${{ github.event.before }}...${{ github.event.after }}" --jq '.files[].filename' || echo __ALL__)
            # the compare endpoint caps the file listing at 300
            if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$FILES" | wc -l)" -ge 300 ]; then
              FILES=__ALL__
            fi
          else
            FILES=__ALL__
          fi

          if [ "$FILES" = "__ALL__" ] || printf '%s\n' "$FILES" \
            | grep -qE '^(create-quasar/|\.github/workflows/create-quasar-tests\.yml)'; then
            echo "e2e=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "e2e=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  # the e2e publishes the monorepo's ui package to its local registry,
  # which needs the build output (same pattern as app-vite-tests.yml)
  build-ui:
    permissions

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
